title: Crombot Takes the Scenic Route
alt: A four-panel comic follows Crombot, a handmade robot car with twin sensor eyes and looping wires, as he avoids a spiral-shelled snail, meets a leaf-hatted figure, and gives the snail a lift through a botanical world.
description: A small detour becomes a new friendship. Crombot meets a leaf-hatted gardener and a snail with somewhere to be.
